cd /app && cat > build.py <<'EOF'
import math, torch, torch.nn as nn

class PositionalEncoding(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, d_model, max_len=5000):
        super().__init__()
        self.register_buffer('pe', torch.zeros(1, max_len, d_model))
    def forward(self, x):
        return x + self.pe[:, :x.size(1)]

class RecoveredModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_dim=64, d_model=128, nhead=8, dim_ff=256,
                 num_enc=3, num_dec=1):
        super().__init__()
        self.embedding = nn.Linear(input_dim, d_model)
        self.pos_encoder = PositionalEncoding(d_model)
        enc_layer = nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(d_model, nhead, dim_ff, batch_first=True)
        self.transformer_encoder = nn.TransformerEncoder(enc_layer, num_enc)
        dec_layer = nn.TransformerDecoderLayer(d_model, nhead, dim_ff, batch_first=True)
        self.transformer_decoder = nn.TransformerDecoder(dec_layer, num_dec)
        self.output_layer = nn.Linear(d_model, input_dim)
    def features(self, src, tgt):
        s = self.pos_encoder(self.embedding(src))
        t = self.pos_encoder(self.embedding(tgt))
        mem = self.transformer_encoder(s)
        return self.transformer_decoder(t, mem)
    def forward(self, src, tgt):
        return self.output_layer(self.features(src, tgt))

torch.manual_seed(0)
sd = torch.load('weights.pt', map_location='cpu')
model = RecoveredModel()
model.load_state_dict(sd)   # verifies exact match
model.eval()

d = torch.load('dataset.pt', map_location='cpu')
src, tgt = d['src_sequences'], d['tgt_sequences']

lossf = nn.MSELoss()
with torch.no_grad():
    orig = lossf(model(src, tgt), tgt).item()
    feats = model.features(src, tgt)   # [B,S,128]

# closed-form linear regression for output_layer
F = feats.reshape(-1, feats.shape[-1])          # N x 128
Y = tgt.reshape(-1, tgt.shape[-1])              # N x 64
ones = torch.ones(F.shape[0], 1)
Faug = torch.cat([F, ones], dim=1)              # N x 129
sol = torch.linalg.lstsq(Faug, Y).solution      # 129 x 64
W = sol[:-1].T.contiguous()                     # 64 x 128
b = sol[-1].contiguous()                        # 64
with torch.no_grad():
    model.output_layer.weight.copy_(W)
    model.output_layer.bias.copy_(b)
    new = lossf(model(src, tgt), tgt).item()

print('orig MSE', orig, 'new MSE', new)
assert new < orig

# verify only output_layer differs
nsd = model.state_dict()
for k in sd:
    if k.startswith('output_layer'):
        continue
    assert torch.equal(nsd[k], sd[k]), k

ts = torch.jit.script(model)
ts.save('model.pt')

# reload + confirm loads original weights & state dict diff
m2 = torch.jit.load('model.pt')
m2.load_state_dict(sd)  # must load original weights with no error
print('scripted reload ok')
EOF
